details:
Description:

When I am typing in the in-game text field (such as chatbox, search bar, or world input) and try to switch my OS input method (IME / language keyboard selection), the entire VRChat client immediately freezes. 

The screen becomes completely unresponsive to any mouse clicks, keyboard shortcuts, or VR controller inputs. The only way to exit the game is to force close it via Alt + F4 or Task Manager.

Reproduction Steps:

1. Open VRChat.

2. Open any text input field (e.g., Chatbox, World Search, or Video Player URL input).

3. Click to focus on the input field and start typing.

4. Press the hotkey to switch the input method (e.g., Shift, Alt+Shift, or Windows Key + Space to toggle between English and Chinese/IME).

5. Observe that the game immediately freezes, UI element clicks stop working, and a force close (Alt+F4) is required.

Expected Behaviour:

The client should handle OS input method switching smoothly without losing window focus or breaking the UI interaction loop.
title: Switching input methods causes VRChat to freeze and become completely unresponsive
